review_notes: I read the whole file. Its only new definition is `Sphere.orthRadius`, defined as `.mk' p (ℝ ∙ (p -ᵥ s.center))ᗮ`. I grepped Mathlib/Geometry and Mathlib for other versions of this concept: tangent spaces, polars, and `mk' … ᗮ` patterns. Other files use the same `mk' … ᗮ` construction directly (Altitude, MongePoint, Projection, Volume/Measure). They use it for different concepts, and none is a named sphere-specific competitor. In Sphere/Tangent.lean and Sphere/PolePolar.lean, `IsTangentAt`, `tangentSet`, `polar` and `pole` are all defined in terms of `orthRadius`. They build on it and do not compete with it. The remaining declarations are lemmas about `orthRadius`, which are outside this rubric. I found no independent duplicate of a Mathlib, Batteries or core concept, so I abstain. The only residual uncertainty is that I did not read every Mathlib file exhaustively.
